Get Started HOME SERVICES OUR WORK ABOUT US CONTACT EXACTA PAINTING LLC RESIDENTIAL PAINTING SPECIALIST SERVICES REPAIRS INTERIORS General and drywall repairs before project to ensure quality finish. Interior painting including ceilings, walls, trim, and more. Polyurethane and stain work available as well. EXTERIORS Exterior painting including fences, porches, brick and vinyl homes. Pressure washing available to insure your house is the best in the neighborhood. OUR WORK A collection of spaces we've renovated with passion ABOUT US Exacta Painting LLC is a locally owned residential painting company operating out of Lexington, Kentucky. Experience painting residential homes and commercial projects we strive to exceed our customer’s expectation in everything we do. We offer an array of services from exterior and interior painting to wood staining and polyurethane work. ​ Regardless of your project, we offer a hassle-free approach to getting a quote and completing the work properly and on time: ​ Quick on-the-spot custom quotes Work directly with the owner, Seth Corman CONTACT US Email: exactapaintingllc@gmail.com Tel: (859) 552-3008 OPENING HOURS: Mon - Fri: 9am - 5pm Enter Your Name Enter Your Email Enter Your Subject Enter Your Message Here Submit CUSTOMER REVIEWS
